points.description: States that in a circular linked list the last element (node) points back to the head (first node) of the list, whereas in a basic linked list the last node does not (it points to null).
points.partial_credit: Half or more of the marks if the answer says the list is circular/loops or the end connects to the start but is vague, or states only the basic list ends in null without the circular link.

points.description: Contrasts with the basic linked list: its last node points to null/nothing rather than to the head.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the last node of a circular list points to the head, in any wording; mentioning the basic list ends in null earns the last mark. Part marks for vague statements such as "it forms a loop" or "end connects to the start" without clearly naming last node and head. No marks for answers that only describe general linked list features or other list types (e.g., doubly linked).
